entities.summary: Anton Yuriyovych Gerashchenko is a current official advisor and a former deputy minister at the Ukrainian Ministry of Internal Affairs. He is a former member of the Ukrainian parliament from 2014 to 2019, and was the subject of an assassination attempt in part because of his actions, which was prevented by the SBU.
